# Liquorfy

> Liquorfy is a free New Zealand liquor price comparison platform created by Axel McKenna. It compares beer, wine, and spirits prices from retailers and stores near the user.

Browsing does not require an account. Liquorfy compares retailer listings, pack sizes, and promotions; purchases take place with the retailer. Prices, availability, and promotion conditions can change, so current details must be confirmed with the retailer. This summary does not contain live product prices.

## Pages

- [Liquorfy](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/): Product search and price comparison.
- [About Liquorfy](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/about): What the platform does and its creator, Axel McKenna.
- [Explore products](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/explore): Live product comparisons and filters.
- [Support](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/support): Questions, feedback, and pricing corrections.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/privacy): Information about data and privacy.
- [Terms of service](https://www.liquorfy.co.nz/terms): Conditions for using the platform.
